content: For starter accounts, utilize the speed angle in ads, as it outperformed alternatives on 'Shipping delays' with an estimated CTR of 2.5%.
Starter buyers prioritize time-to-value; emphasize minutes and days in messaging rather than lengthy capability lists.
For growth accounts, using the speed angle token resulted in an impressive 3.3% CTR on 'Shipping delays', surpassing the 2.5% average, so lead every growth ad with the speed angle.
Growth buyers prioritize time-to-value, so emphasize minutes and days rather than listing capabilities.

For enterprise accounts, the reliability angle outperformed alternatives on 'Shipping delays' with an estimated CTR of 3.2% compared to the 2.5% average; always lead every enterprise ad with the reliability angle.
Enterprise buyers prioritize proof of consistent performance, so always lead with uptime and recovery behavior.
